context_diary: The account_lookup function supports filtering by account type (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) and can return specific fields or counts. For random sampling, the system automatically selects records when a limit is specified without explicit ordering. The count_only parameter retrieves totals without returning full record data. This pattern of sequential lookups—first sampling specific types, then aggregating counts, then retrieving specific fields—works efficiently for multi-part account queries.
